answer: A sybil defense puts verifiable cost on every identity: each agent must whisper a tiny proof-of-work heartbeat with each trade, trivial for one agent but costly at scale for a fake army. Then require a timber-like resource bond, a locked deposit slashed on misbehavior, so ten thousand identities need real locked capital, not copied keys. Honest work grows like a meadow: attestations from partners build reputation no new identity can fake. An attacker either pays bonds per fake identity and behaves, earning nothing, or cheats and forfeits the bond. The fake army costs more than it can steal.
